text:
Ben: hi all, day 1 — trying to validate a demo that needs both an S3 bucket in eu-central-1 and a GCS bucket in europe-west3. hitting permission errors on both sides and not sure who owns the cross-account mappings.
Lena (cloud-onboarding): welcome Ben! can you paste the errors and the account/project ids? also did you join the okta group `redwood-devs`? region access sometimes tied to group mapping.
Ben: aws error when creating S3: 
ERROR: AccessDenied: User arn:aws:iam::210987654321:user/ben is not authorized to perform: s3:CreateBucket on resource arn:aws:s3:::redwood-demo-eu
GCP error when creating bucket: 
ERROR: (gcloud.storage.buckets.create) PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission storage.buckets.create denied on project proj-ben-demo (role roles/storage.admin missing)
Ben: aws account 210987654321, gcp project proj-ben-demo. i am in okta but not sure about group membership.
Ops Bot: Quick checks: 1) Confirm Okta group sync: https://redwood.internal/okta/groups. 2) AWS cross-account roles require `sts:AssumeRole` mapping in the trust policy. 3) GCP needs project-level IAM or folder role.
Grace (billing): FYI billing looks fine for both accounts; no spending block. If access requires an org-wide billing-confirm we can skip.
Tom (security): we enforce least-privilege. For AWS create bucket you need either S3 full access or a team role. Check `aws iam list-attached-user-policies --user-name ben`.
Sam (infra): Ben, run `aws sts get-caller-identity` to confirm principal and `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` to see why s3:CreateBucket is denied. For GCP run `gcloud projects get-iam-policy proj-ben-demo` to inspect bindings.
Ben: ran both. AWS shows no S3 policy attached. GCP policy shows no roles/storage.admin binding for my user or group.
Lena (cloud-onboarding): likely onboarding step missed: we add new hires to the `redwood-devs` okta group which maps to `roles/ProjectEditor` on dev projects and `team-s3-access` role on AWS. I'll check Okta sync.
Lena (cloud-onboarding): Okta recently had a sync issue yesterday; ben wasn't auto-added. Sam, can you trigger a manual sync or add ben to the devs group?
Sam (infra): done — added ben@redwood.com to okta group redwood-devs; triggered sync. It may take ~2 minutes to propagate.
Ben: still denied after 3 mins. any manual interim we can do?
Tom (security): for emergency onboarding we can issue a short-lived temp role: AWS role `dev-onboard-assume` for 8 hours and GCP binding roles/storage.objectAdmin for the project for 8 hours. Need manager approval.
Ben: my manager approved in-thread: "approve temporary access for day-1 demo"
Sam (infra): created temp aws role dev-onboard-assume with trust for ben, expiry 8h. GCP binding roles/storage.objectAdmin added to proj-ben-demo for ben@gmail? (using his SAML principal). Ticket ACC-2032-77.
Ben: retried aws create bucket — success. gcp create bucket also works. amazing. thank you.
Lena (cloud-onboarding): note: we'll update onboarding doc to include checking Okta group sync and this temp-access flow. Ben, please remove any demo data and confirm when done so we can revoke the temp grants early if wanted.
Ben: will tear down after demo and post here. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
